shapeSummary: Simplified Tamiya double gearbox: a 60 x 40 x 23 mm rectangular housing block with its bottom at Y=0. Two 20 mm diameter motor cylinders sit side by side and extend 30 mm beyond the housing, for 70 mm total height along Y. A single 3 mm through-hole runs along X through the housing as the axle bore. The gears, internal cavities, windows, screws and the protruding hex axles are omitted.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified estimates taken from the supplied boundsMm (60 x 70 x 23).

Y is treated as the 70 mm motor-length axis, as the analysis notes describe, with Y=0 at the bottom of the part. The photo suggests the motors may actually lie parallel to the axle, so the orientation is uncertain.
The 40 mm housing length and 20 mm motor diameter are guesses.
The 3 mm axle bore is placed at Y=12 mm, Z=0, a guessed position. The second axle and the real axle offsets are not located.
The protruding 3 mm hex axles are excluded, because the bounds exclude the axle tips.
The gear cavities, side windows, screw holes, mounting tabs and motor end details are omitted because they are not dimensioned.
cadquery:
housing = cq.Workplane('XY').box(60, 40, 23, centered=(True, False, True))
motors = (cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 40, 0))
          .pushPoints([(-15, 0), (15, 0)])
          .circle(10)
          .extrude(-30))
part = housing.union(motors)
axle_hole = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(-30, 12, 0)).circle(1.5).extrude(60)
part = part.cut(axle_hole)
